env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: HTTP API only; no required vendor Python SDK.

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Short description field returned with each result.

content.comment: Search returns markdown page bodies unless `X-Respond-With: no-content` is set.

mode.comment: Reader Search has no vendor fast/synthesis mode knob. Default returns SERP + optional page markdown; `X-Respond-With: no-content` is a fetch shortcut, not a latency tier.

pricing_per_1k.value: Token-priced: ≥10K tokens/request; $50/1B tokens implies ≥$0.50 / 1K, not flat CPM
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Token-priced; lower-bound request estimate is not a flat price

free_tier_limits.value: 10M free tokens listed with noncommercial CC-BY-NC condition; recurrence unverified
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: Search: 0.75s p50 / 1.32s p95 independent; 2.5s provider-reported average
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Independent percentiles use three 2,000-query runs from the US East Coast. Jina's current rate-limit table reports a 2.5-second average for s.jina.ai.

native_api.value: s.jina.ai requires key; r.jina.ai URL reader uses separate output-token billing.

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
